# agentbox

> Personal Claude Code Plugin Marketplace & Oh My Pi (omp) Developer Toolkit by duythien0912.

Modular visual artifact generators, durable multi-agent orchestration loops, and eval-gated optimization engines.

## Installation

### Claude Code
```text
/plugin marketplace add duythien0912/agentbox
/plugin install agentbox@agentbox
```

### Oh My Pi (omp)
```bash
bash scripts/setup-omp.sh
```

## Skills Catalog (19 Skills)

- `agentbox:guide`: Interactive concierge router mapping user goals to the right skill or agent.
- `agentbox:pr-writeup`: Turn any pull request into a self-contained HTML writeup (TL;DR, tour, test plan).
- `agentbox:plan-deck`: Turn a spec into an HTML implementation plan (timeline, data flow, mockups, risks).
- `agentbox:codewalk`: Trace a code path into a self-contained HTML walkthrough with file:line refs.
- `agentbox:flowchart`: Interactive Mermaid flowchart with per-node detail panels (CDN rendering).
- `agentbox:component-diagram`: Interactive component diagram with boundaries and typed dependencies.
- `agentbox:sequence-diagram`: Time-ordered sequence diagram with step-driven detail panel.
- `agentbox:c4-model`: LikeC4 multi-view architectural diagrams (Container, Component, Landscape).
- `agentbox:deep-understanding`: Interactive tutor assessing and quizzing understanding of a diff or subsystem.
- `agentbox:conductor`: Durable workflow runner with crash resume, worktree isolation, and enforcement gates.
- `agentbox:prospector`: Sequential keep-or-discard hill-climbing loop for code scalars (perf, memory, latency).
- `agentbox:whetstone`: Overnight eval-gated skill improver grinding a backlog through frozen checks.
- `agentbox:arena`: Reproducible pairwise leaderboard evaluating conductor outputs across test fixtures.
- `agentbox:loom`: Graph-shaped delivery loop with fork/rejoin regions, verified invariants, and browser preview.
- `agentbox:lanes`: External-agent execution model with append-only ledger and state drift reconciliation.
- `agentbox:lane-config`: Per-repo orchestration configuration for model effort, lane caps, and timeouts.
- `agentbox:skill-lint`: Deterministic analyzer auditing word budgets, structural tags, and triggers.
- `agentbox:plan-check`: Pre-flight plan audit against codebase evidence emitting GO/NO-GO reports.
- `agentbox:feedback`: User feedback intake converting experience into scrubbed GitHub issues.

## Agents Catalog (10 Agents)

### Directly Usable Subagents (Public)
- `agentbox-planner`: Scopes goals into grounded code decomposition and executable acceptance criteria.
- `agentbox-builder`: Implements scoped slice in an isolated worktree against external acceptance criteria.
- `agentbox-verifier`: Independently verifies results at a named SHA; proves checks can fail; reports numbers.
- `agentbox-code-reviewer`: Reviews changed code on a branch and fixes Critical/High findings in one pass.

### Automated Gate Workers (Conductor / Lanes)
- `agentbox-test-writer`: Writes failing tests FIRST (RED step) from acceptance criteria.
- `agentbox-tryve-enhancer`: Hardens coverage for error paths, boundaries, auth, and concurrency.
- `agentbox-docs-writer`: Generates concise implementation summaries under `docs/changes/`.
- `agentbox-web-verifier`: Web E2E testing writing Playwright specs and capturing viewport screenshots.
- `agentbox-mobile-verifier`: Mobile app verification across React Native, Flutter, and native simulators.
- `agentbox-herdr-orchestrator`: Drives multi-agent sessions across external panes with strict adjudication.
